# Kinosail

> Kinosail Player is a free, self-hosted media server and web player for movies, TV shows, music, audiobooks, books, comics, and photos. It runs as one Docker container on Linux (amd64 or arm64), a NAS, or Proxmox, reads media folders read-only, and needs no vendor account. Remote streaming, hardware transcoding, and automatic intro and credits skipping are free. It is a private alternative to Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. Kinosail Subtitles is a separate free app that finds and saves subtitle files.

Key facts:

- Price: the Server, web Player, remote streaming, and hardware transcoding are free. There is no paid tier.
- License: source-available under the PolyForm Perimeter License 1.0.1. It is not OSI-approved open source.
- Install: Docker image `ghcr.io/kinosail/kinosail-player:latest`, web port 38127, media mounted read-only at `/media`.
- Clients: web Player in modern browsers; AirPlay, Google Cast, and DLNA playback; compatible Jellyfin mobile apps; native iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Apple Watch, Android, Android TV, and Wear OS apps as source builds (no store release yet).
- Hardware acceleration: Intel Quick Sync, NVIDIA, AMD, VA-API, Apple VideoToolbox, Rockchip, and V4L2.
- Accounts: Owner and Viewer Profiles on each Server, passkeys, TOTP multi-factor authentication, optional OIDC, SAML, and SCIM.
- Migration: imports watched state, resume positions, favorites, and playlists from Plex or Jellyfin, with preview and optional recurring sync.
- Not included: live TV and DVR.
- Integrations: versioned HTTP API with OpenAPI, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, webhooks, TMDB metadata (optional).

- [Install with Docker]({{ '/quickstart/' | absolute_url }}): Docker Compose, docker run, and a signed, pinned installer.
- [Install on a NAS or Proxmox]({{ '/getting-started/platforms/' | absolute_url }}): TrueNAS, Unraid, ZimaOS, CasaOS, Synology, QNAP, Portainer, Dockge, and Proxmox VE.
- [Complete first setup]({{ '/getting-started/first-setup/' | absolute_url }}): create the Owner, secure the account, and add Profiles.

## Compare

- [Plex vs Jellyfin vs Emby vs Kinosail]({{ '/compare/' | absolute_url }})
- [Kinosail vs Plex]({{ '/compare/plex/' | absolute_url }}): free remote streaming and hardware transcoding without Plex Pass.
- [Kinosail vs Jellyfin]({{ '/compare/jellyfin/' | absolute_url }}): both free; built-in passkeys and MFA versus plugins and live TV.
- [Kinosail vs Emby]({{ '/compare/emby/' | absolute_url }}): hardware transcoding and skip intro without Emby Premiere.
- [Import history from Plex or Jellyfin]({{ '/owner-guide/migration/' | absolute_url }})
